堅韌前行 穩步增長
Building Resilience for Growth


大新銀行作為一家在香港擁有超過77年歷史的本地銀行，一直秉
持業務穩健的理念，在瞬息萬變的營商和經濟環境中，不斷強化
營運和財務實力與韌性，致力實現為客戶、員工、股東及其他持份
者創造可持續和穏定增長的承諾。


As a local bank established for over 77 years in Hong Kong,
Dah Sing Bank is committed to building operational and
financial strength and resilience through different business
and economic cycles, delivering on our promise to create
sustainable and stable growth for our customers, employees,
shareholders and other stakeholders.

for approximately 16% of total lending in the first half of
2024 according to statistics from Standard & Poor, any
sector-related pressure would weigh on banksʼ asset
quality, and no market player in the territory would be
immune to this trend.

     環境、社會及管治

     環境、社會及管治（
             「ESG」
                 ）考慮因素錯綜複雜地交織在我們的業務策略和運營結構中。本集團仍舊關注不斷變化的
     市場趨勢，並積極完善其可持續發展實踐。本集團在其全面的環境、社會及管治策略指導下，專注於以下關鍵範疇，
     努力持續改善，並努力為自身及更廣泛的社會創造可持續和有韌性之未來。



     環境、社會及管治之管治          在董事會監管下，加強環境、社會及管治的定位，並監督氣候轉型計劃的制定


     管治                   在環境、社會及管治的監督和策略實施方面，建立明確的問責制度

     溝通                   就我們的環境、社會及管治計劃，定期與內、外持份者保持溝通

     報告                   持續改善披露質素及表現追蹤水平



     綠色及可持續銀行             監督大新銀行集團內綠色及可持續銀行的實務及其相關策略


     管治                   確定並實施與綠色及可持續銀行業務，及氣候風險相關的整體框架與
                           相關策略



     以客戶為中心               提升客戶體驗，加強以客為本的精神


     客戶滿意度                憑藉卓越的客戶體驗及優質的產品和服務，與客戶建立彼此信賴的長
                           期關係



     市場                   專注服務中小企

      擔，而其存在只能就集團控制範圍以外之一    past events and whose existence will only be confirmed by the

      質確定有收益獲得時，則被確認為資產。     benefits is probable. When such inflow is virtually certain, an asset

      3.3 市場風險                 3.3 Market risk

      市場風險乃指由市場上利率及價格不利變化      Market risk is the risk of losses in assets, liabilities and off-balance
      而引致對資產、負債及資產負債表外持倉之      sheet positions arising from adverse movements in market rates
      虧損風險。                    and prices.

      各類交易之市場風險均由董事會、風險管理      Market risk exposure for different types of transactions is managed
      及合規委員會及財資及投資風險委員會按       within various risk limits and guidelines approved by the Board,
      董事會授予之權力所核准之各項風險限額及      the RMCC and the TIRC under the authority delegated from
      指引內處理。風險限額按組合層面以及各產      the Board. Risk limits are set at the portfolio level as well as by
      品及不同風險類別設定。該等限額綜合包含      products and by different types of risks. The risk limits comprise
      了名義金額、止蝕限額、敏感度及運用風險值     a combination of notional, stop-loss, sensitivity and value-at-risk
      （
      「風險值」）之監控。所有涉及市場風險的交     (“VaR”) controls. All trading positions are subject to daily mark-to-
      易持倉需要每日按市值入賬。集團風險部之      market valuation. The Risk Management and Control Department
      風險管理及監控部（「風險管理及監控部」
                        ）乃     (“RMCD”) within the GRD, as an independent risk management
      一個獨立之風險管理及控制部門，負責比較      and control unit, identifies, measures, monitors and controls the
      風險和已審批限額，以識別、計量、監控及管     risk exposures against approved limits and initiates specific actions
      理該等風險及提議具體行動去確保持倉被限      to ensure positions are managed within an acceptable level. Any
      制在可接受水平內。任何不符合限額情況均      exceptions have to be reviewed and sanctioned by the appropriate
      須依據有關政策及程序經合適管理層－財資      level of management of TIRC, RMCC or the Board as stipulated in
      及投資風險委員會，風險管理及合規委員會      the relevant policies and procedures.
      或董事會審查及批准。

      大新銀行之附屬公司澳門商業銀行股份有限      Banco Comercial de Macau, S.A. (“BCM”) and Dah Sing Bank
      公司（
        「澳門商業銀行」 ）及大新銀行（中國）有   (China) Limited (“DSB China”), which are subsidiaries of DSB, run
      限公司（「大新銀行（中國）」
                   ）根據其一套自定    their treasury functions locally under their own set of limits and
      限額和政策及在大新銀行設定之市場風險管      policies and within the market risk management framework set by

            框架。董事會授權財資及投資風險委員                                  governance and control processes of the Group. It delegates
            會監管金融工具之估值程序。估值由風                                  the responsibility for overseeing the valuation process for
            險管理及監控部和獨立專業合資格估值                                  financial instruments to the TIRC. Valuation is performed
            師及精算師（如適用）獨立地進行，而估                                 independently by RMCD and where appropriate, by
            值結果乃定期驗證，確保公平值計量過                                  independent and professionally qualified valuers and
            程之完整性。                                             actuaries and the valuation results are periodically verified to
                                                               ensure the integrity of the fair value measurement process.

            金融工具之公平值乃在目前市場情況下                                  The fair value of financial instruments is the price that would
            市場參與者於計量日進行之有序交易中                                  be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability
            出售資產所收取或轉移負債所支付之價                                  in an orderly transaction between market participants at
            格，不論該價格為直接可觀察或使用估                                  the measurement date under current market conditions
            值方法估計。                                             regardless of whether that price is directly observable or
                                                               estimated using a valuation technique.

         。                     debt funding (including subordinated notes).

就編製分項報告而言，對可直接認明為各個       For the purpose of segment reporting, revenue derived from
別分項之源自客戶、產品及服務收入，將直接      customers, products and services directly identifiable with
呈報於有關分項；而分項之間的資金運用及       individual segments are reported directly under respective
資金資源所產生的收入和資金成本，按參照       segments, while revenue and funding cost arising from inter-
市場利率之轉移價格機制分配至各分項。分       segment funding operation and funding resources are allocated
項間之交易乃依據授予第三者或與第三者交       to segments by way of transfer pricing mechanism with reference
易之同類條款定價。分項間之收入或支出於       to market interest rates. Transactions within segments are priced
綜合賬內抵銷。                   based on similar terms offered to or transacted with external
                          parties. Inter-segment income or expenses are eliminated on
                          consolidation.

所有不同分項之直接開支將歸類於有關的分       All direct costs incurred by different segments are grouped under
項分類。間接開支及支援部門開支乃依據開       respective segments. Indirect costs and support functionsʼ costs
支性質，按耗用之時間及工作量和分項營運       are allocated to various segments and products based on effort
收入，分配至不同的分項及產品。不能合理地      and time spent as well as segmentsʼ operating income depending
分配至各分項、產品及支援部門之企業活動       on the nature of costs incurred. Costs related to corporate activities
開支，則作企業開支呈列於
           「其他」項下。        that cannot be reasonably allocated to segments, products and

製。所應用之貼現率乃基於本集團及其銀行                      Senior Management based on their evaluation of the businesses

                    。 減值評估並非以            will operate over the projection period. The discount rate used is

43. 有關連人士之交易               43. RELATED-PARTY TRANSACTIONS
有關連人士為該等人士有能力直接或間接控        Related parties are those parties, which have the ability, directly
制另一方，或對另一方在作出財務及營運決        or indirectly, to control the other party or exercise significant
策方面行使重大影響力。倘若其他不同人士        influence over the other party in making financial and operating
受到共同控制或共同重大影響時，彼等人士        decisions. Parties are also considered to be related if they are
亦被視為有關連人士。                 subject to common control or common significant influence.

於2024年及2023年，本集團於正常業務中曾    During 2024 and 2023, a number of banking continuing connected
與有關連人士進行銀行業務交易。本公司獨        transactions were entered into with related parties in the normal
立非執行董事在檢閱本集團之綜合財務報表        course of business of the Group. These, as described in Note (a)
時，已對該等如下列註（甲）敍述及屬於持續       below and being continuing connected transactions, had been
有關連之交易進行審閱。該等董事根據其檢        reviewed by the Companyʼs independent non-executive directors
閱及根據向管理層之詢問，認為全部持續有        in their review of the consolidated financial statements of the
關連之交易乃根據本集團之正常業務、有關        Group. Based on their review and enquiry with management, the
協議、一般商業條款及慣例，按公平且合理及       Companyʼs independent non-executive directors were satisfied
符合本公司股東整體利益進行。             that all of the continuing connected transactions were conducted
                           in the ordinary and usual course of business of the Group, on
                           normal commercial terms, and in accordance with relevant
                           agreements on terms that are fair and reasonable and in the
                           interests of the shareholders of the Company as a whole.

      總體淨額結算安排                     Master netting arrangements

      本集團會盡可能與交易對手訂立總體淨額結          To mitigate credit risks, the Group enters into master netting
      算安排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規          arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
      定，一旦出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之         agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all
      未完成交易均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼          outstanding transactions with the counterparty will be terminated
      合按淨額結算。如非發生違約事件，所有與對         and all amounts outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except
      手之交易會以總額結算及一般不會在綜合財          for the event of default, all outstanding transactions with the
      務狀況表中對銷資產及負債。                counterparty are settled on a gross basis and generally do not
                                   result in offsetting the assets and liabilities in the consolidated
                                   statement of financial position.
